N-S1.question: In PostgreSQL, how do I list the financial amounts per year together with the name of the company?
N-S1.answer:
The metadata shows `companyfinancials.year` and `companyfinancials.amount`, and a tentative reference candidate from `companyfinancials.companyid` to `company.companyid`. It also shows `company.entityname` and `company.fullname` as available company-name-like fields. A list query using `entityname` is:

```sql
SELECT
  c.entityname AS company_name,
  cf.year,
  cf.amount
FROM public.companyfinancials AS cf
JOIN public.company AS c
  ON cf.companyid = c.companyid
ORDER BY cf.year;
```
